name: Power Word Stun
description: Level 8 Enchantment (Bard, Tidecaller, Warlock, Shipwright) Casting Time: Action Range: 60 feet Components: V Duration: Instantaneous You overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range. If the target has 150 Health or fewer, it has the Stunned condition. Otherwise, its Speed is 0 until the start of your next turn. The Stunned target makes a Resolve saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success.
